question.problem:
Given that $X$ is a continuous random variable with the following probability density function, compute $\text{Var}[X].$ 

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{30(x-1)}{{x}^{7}},\, & x\ge 1, \\ 0,\, & \text{otherwise.}\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
For a continuous random variable $X$ with probability density function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S,$ we can calculate the variance using the following formula:

$$
\text{Var}[X]=\text{E}[{X}^{2}]-\text{E}[X]^{2}
$$

 

First, we compute $\text{E}[X]:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & ={\int }_{1}^{\infty }x\cdot \frac{30(x-1)}{{x}^{7}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{\infty }\frac{30x-30}{{x}^{6}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{\infty }\frac{30}{{x}^{5}}-\frac{30}{{x}^{6}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =-\frac{30}{4{x}^{4}}+\frac{30}{5{x}^{5}}{|}_{1}^{\infty } \\  & =-\frac{15}{2{x}^{4}}+\frac{6}{{x}^{5}}{|}_{1}^{\infty } \\  & =\frac{3}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we compute $\text{E}[{X}^{2}]:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[{X}^{2}] & ={\int }_{1}^{\infty }{x}^{2}\cdot \frac{30(x-1)}{{x}^{7}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{\infty }\frac{30x-30}{{x}^{5}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{\infty }\frac{30}{{x}^{4}}-\frac{30}{{x}^{5}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =-\frac{30}{3{x}^{3}}+\frac{30}{4{x}^{4}}{|}_{1}^{\infty } \\  & =-\frac{10}{{x}^{3}}+\frac{15}{2{x}^{4}}{|}_{1}^{\infty } \\  & =\frac{5}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the variance is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[X] & =\text{E}[{X}^{2}]-\text{E}[X]^{2} \\  & =\frac{5}{2}-{(\frac{3}{2})}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$
